tools.description: Settings per tool. A builtin tool takes the keys listed here; an MCP or connector tool takes any keys.

outside_workdir.description: What happens when a file or shell tool call reaches a path outside the working directory and its added directories: 'ask' prompts for approval, 'deny' refuses the call and tells the agent why, so it keeps working. Allowlisted paths are unaffected. Override per tool with 'outside_workdir' under [tools.<name>].

enabled_tools.description: An explicit list of tool names/patterns to enable. If set, only these tools will be active. Supports glob patterns (e.g., 'serena_*') and regex with 're:' prefix (e.g., 're:^serena_.*').
enabled_tools.title: Enabled Tools

disabled_tools.description: A list of tool names/patterns to disable after 'enabled_tools' filtering. Supports glob patterns and regex with 're:' prefix.
disabled_tools.title: Disabled Tools

experimental_enable_document_library_con.description: Experimental: expose the Mistral document_library connector and its MCP tools. Off by default while the backend endpoints are stabilized; when enabled, document_library is requested from the connector bootstrap alongside web_search.
experimental_enable_document_library_con.title: Experimental Enable Document Library Connector

experimental_enable_mistral_mcp_connecto.description: Experimental: expose the Mistral MCP builtin connector and its tools. Rolled out through the vibe_cli_mistral_mcp_connector GrowthBook experiment.
experimental_enable_mistral_mcp_connecto.title: Experimental Enable Mistral Mcp Connector

agent_paths.description: Additional directories to search for custom agent profiles. Each path may be absolute or relative to the current working directory.
agent_paths.title: Agent Paths

enabled_agents.description: An explicit list of agent names/patterns to enable. If set, only these agents will be available. Supports glob patterns (e.g., 'custom-*') and regex with 're:' prefix.
enabled_agents.title: Enabled Agents

disabled_agents.description: A list of agent names/patterns to disable. Ignored if 'enabled_agents' is set. Supports glob patterns and regex with 're:' prefix.
disabled_agents.title: Disabled Agents

installed_agents.description: A list of opt-in builtin agent names that have been explicitly installed.
installed_agents.title: Installed Agents

default_agent.description: Agent profile to use when no --agent flag is passed. Builtin: ask, accept-edits, smart-approve, auto-approve. Applies in both interactive and programmatic (-p/--prompt) mode.
default_agent.title: Default Agent

smart_approve_available.description: Expose the smart-approve mode in the mode picker/cycle. Set by the vibe_cli_smart_approve experiment; does not change the default.
smart_approve_available.title: Smart Approve Available

enable_auto_approve.description: Allow the auto-approve (YOLO) mode: the 'auto-approve' agent and the --auto-approve/--yolo flag. When false, no agent with the 'yolo' safety level is available and the flag and bypass_tool_permissions are ignored (per-tool permissions still apply). Intended for admin-managed (enterprise) config to forbid auto-approving tool calls.
enable_auto_approve.title: Enable Auto Approve

skill_paths.description: Additional directories to search for skills. Each path may be absolute or relative to the current working directory.
skill_paths.title: Skill Paths

enabled_skills.description: An explicit list of skill names/patterns to enable. If set, only these skills will be active. Supports glob patterns (e.g., 'search-*') and regex with 're:' prefix.
enabled_skills.title: Enabled Skills

disabled_skills.description: A list of skill names/patterns to disable. Ignored if 'enabled_skills' is set. Supports glob patterns and regex with 're:' prefix.
disabled_skills.title: Disabled Skills

enabled_plugins.description: Names of installed plugins to turn on that are off by default. 'disabled_plugins' wins when a plugin is in both.
enabled_plugins.title: Enabled Plugins

disabled_plugins.description: Names of installed plugins to disable. A disabled plugin stays installed but contributes nothing to sessions.
disabled_plugins.title: Disabled Plugins

experimental_enable_registry_skills.description: Experimental: pull shared workspace skills from Mistral (api.mistral.ai) and make them available alongside local skills. Requires a Mistral provider and API key. On a name collision the project's skills win over global ones, skill_paths included, and within a scope a local skill wins over a shared one. Builtin skills are named vibe:<name>, so they never collide.
experimental_enable_registry_skills.title: Experimental Enable Registry Skills

experimental_enable_model_catalog.description: Experimental: fetch the curated model catalog from the Mistral provider at session start and cache it per user on disk. Requires a Mistral provider and API key; any failure silently falls back to local config.
experimental_enable_model_catalog.title: Experimental Enable Model Catalog

experimental_enable_local_projects.description: Experimental, in development: switch Vibe Desktop to local projects (local_projects.toml) instead of project links. Not used yet. Read once when Vibe Desktop starts its app server.
experimental_enable_local_projects.title: Experimental Enable Local Projects

enable_pr_monitoring.description: Detect pull requests and merge requests created during a session (gh pr create, glab mr create) and discover the ones that already exist for the session's repository at session load (gh pr list, glab mr list), persist them as session artifacts, keep their status in sync with the provider, and expose them via the artifacts/ RPC namespace. Requires gh/glab (system-installed or bundled).
enable_pr_monitoring.title: Enable Pr Monitoring

experimental_local_runtime_session_api.description: Experimental: the app server drives local Sessions through the Session API instead of calling the local runtime directly. Set by the vibe_cli_local_runtime_session_api_migration experiment; the VIBE_EXPERIMENTAL_LOCAL_RUNTIME_SESSION_API environment variable takes precedence. Read when a Session opens.
experimental_local_runtime_session_api.title: Experimental Local Runtime Session Api

enable_otel.description: Export OpenTelemetry traces for agent, model, and tool operations. Requires enable_telemetry to be enabled.
enable_otel.title: Enable Otel

otel_endpoint.description: Base URL of a custom OTLP/HTTP collector. Vibe appends /v1/traces. When empty, Vibe uses the configured Mistral telemetry endpoint.
otel_endpoint.title: Otel Endpoint

otel_redaction.description: Client-side span attribute redaction: default redacts sensitive values, strict redacts sensitive attributes, and none disables redaction.

cursor_blink.description: Blink the input cursor. Disable for a steady cursor.
cursor_blink.title: Cursor Blink

vim_keybindings.description: Edit the prompt input with vim Normal and Insert modes.
vim_keybindings.title: Vim Keybindings

show_greeting.description: Show greeting at startup (Mistral providers only, once per 24h).
show_greeting.title: Show Greeting

enable_mouse_capture.description: Capture the mouse for scrolling, clicks and in-app selection. Disable to keep the terminal's native text selection.
enable_mouse_capture.title: Enable Mouse Capture

enable_sticky_prompt.description: Pin the prompt of the conversation section at the top of the transcript while scrolling; a click scrolls back to it.
enable_sticky_prompt.title: Enable Sticky Prompt

enable_file_autocomplete.description: Offer @ file mentions with repository file completion. Disable to skip building the file index and watching the filesystem for it.
enable_file_autocomplete.title: Enable File Autocomplete

displayed_workdir.description: Deprecated: accepted for older configs, with no effect on Unified execution.
displayed_workdir.title: Displayed Workdir

context_warnings.description: Deprecated: accepted for older configs, with no effect on Unified execution.
context_warnings.title: Context Warnings

show_subagent_status_list.description: Show the subagent status list and read-only transcript views in the interactive prompt.
show_subagent_status_list.title: Show Subagent Status List

worktree_limit.description: Maximum number of recent managed worktrees kept locally.
worktree_limit.title: Worktree Limit

worktree_copy_on_write.description: macOS only: create managed worktrees of a trusted repository by cloning an idle template checkout with APFS copy-on-write, which uses less disk and is faster on large repositories. Keeps one template checkout per repository under ~/.vibe/worktrees/.templates, and sets extensions.worktreeConfig in the repository's .git/config. Falls back to a normal checkout.
worktree_copy_on_write.title: Worktree Copy On Write

raise_on_compaction_failure.description: Deprecated: accepted for older configs, with no effect on Unified execution.
raise_on_compaction_failure.title: Raise On Compaction Failure

enable_background_processes.description: Offer the agent background processes (tools.process in run_typescript). Off, commands only run to completion in the foreground.
enable_background_processes.title: Enable Background Processes

enable_subagents.description: Offer the agent subagents (tools.subagent in run_typescript). Off, the agent works alone.
enable_subagents.title: Enable Subagents

max_subagents.description: Maximum number of subagents that can be alive at once; a spawn beyond this fails until a subagent is stopped.
max_subagents.title: Max Subagents

max_concurrent_subagents.description: Maximum number of subagents running a turn at the same time; spawning or messaging beyond this fails until a subagent finishes its turn.
max_concurrent_subagents.title: Max Concurrent Subagents

include_model_info.description: Retired: accepted for older configs, with no effect.
include_model_info.title: Include Model Info

include_prompt_detail.description: Retired: accepted for older configs, with no effect.
include_prompt_detail.title: Include Prompt Detail

strict_config.description: Refuse a config with settings Vibe does not use (unknown, retired, or without effect) instead of warning about them. For programmatic and headless runs; also VIBE_STRICT_CONFIG=1.
strict_config.title: Strict Config

api_stream_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of silence after the model starts answering before the response counts as stalled and is retried once. 0 allows the same silence as before the first output (api_timeout). Unified harness only.
api_stream_idle_timeout.title: Api Stream Idle Timeout

agent_max_output_tokens.description: Output token cap sent as max_tokens on every agent and subagent request, whatever the provider, held to the model's max output and to the room the context window leaves above the compaction threshold. 0 sends a cap only where the provider requires one: the model's max_output_tokens. Unified harness only.
agent_max_output_tokens.title: Agent Max Output Tokens

compaction_max_output_tokens.description: Output token cap sent as max_tokens on every compaction request, whatever the provider, held to the compaction model's max output and to the room its context window leaves above the compaction threshold. 0 sends a cap only where the provider requires one: the compaction model's max_output_tokens. Unified harness only.
compaction_max_output_tokens.title: Compaction Max Output Tokens

compaction_reasoning_limit_tokens.description: Approximate reasoning tokens after which the first compaction request is stopped, as if cut off at its output limit, and the summary is asked for once more, briefly, without tools and with reasoning off or at its lowest level. Reasoning is no longer watched once the answer starts. 0 disables the limit. Unified harness only.
compaction_reasoning_limit_tokens.title: Compaction Reasoning Limit Tokens

output_limit_retries.description: Answers cut off at the output token limit that a turn discards and asks again for, with feedback asking for a shorter response. 0 ends the turn on the first cut-off answer. Unified harness only.
output_limit_retries.title: Output Limit Retries

api_connect_timeout.description: Retired: accepted for older configs, with no effect.
api_connect_timeout.title: Api Connect Timeout

api_write_timeout.title: Api Write Timeout
